Name: Custom Starter Package
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod lets you replace the starter package contents in the farmhouse with a list you create using Content Patcher.

I have include an example pack in the Files tab. A basic content.json file looks like this:

[code]﻿{
    "Format": "1.23.0",
    "Changes": [
        {
            "Action": "EditData",
            "Target": "aedenthorn.CustomStarterPackage/dictionary",
            "Entries": {
                "aedenthorn.CSPTestCP/ParsnipSeeds": {
                    "NameOrIndex": "Parsnip Seeds",
                    "Type": "Object",
                    "MinAmount": 15,
                    "MaxAmount": 20,
                    "ChancePercent": 100,
                    "MinQuality": 0,
                    "MaxQuality": 0
                }
            }
        }
    ]
}
[/code]
Entry keys must be unique; you can install multiple content packs and each will add its own items to the package.

[list]
[*][b]NameOrIndex[/b] can be either the key (index) or the first field (name) in the item's data file (e.g. [b]Data/ObjectInformation[/b])
[*][b]Type[/b] can be one of the following:
[b]Object [/b]- uses Data/ObjectInformation[b]
Chest [/b]- uses Data/ObjectInformation[b]
BigCraftable [/b]- uses Data/BigCraftablesInformation[b]Hat [/b]- uses Data/hats[b]
Boots [/b]- uses Data/Boots[b]Clothing [/b]- uses Data/ClothingInformation[b]Ring [/b]- uses Data/ObjectInformation[b]Furniture [/b]- uses Data/Furniture[b]Pickaxe [/b]- put the upgrade level in NameOrIndex (e.g. 3 for Gold)[b]Axe [/b]- put the upgrade level in NameOrIndex (e.g. 3 for Gold)[b]FishingRod [/b]- put the upgrade level in NameOrIndex[b]
Hoe [/b]- put the upgrade level in NameOrIndex (e.g. 3 for Gold)[b]WateringCan [/b]- put the upgrade level in NameOrIndex (e.g. 3 for Gold)[b]MeleeWeapon [/b]- uses Data/weapons[b]
Pan
[/b][b]Shears
[/b][*]use [b]MinAmount [/b]and [b]MaxAmount[/b] for items that can stack
[*][b]ChancePercent[/b] means the chance that the item gets included
[*]use [b]MinQuality[/b] and [b]MaxQuality[/b] for items that have quality (e.g. crop harvest)
[/list]

[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

﻿﻿If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
